feedback: The test cases for requirement R004 (support for parentheses, including nested parentheses) are well-designed and directly exercise the stated requirement. Test R004-T01 evaluates nested parentheses with addition and multiplication, correctly reflecting the precedence and left-to-right evaluation for operators of equal precedence. Test R004-T02 tests deeply nested parentheses with subtraction and multiplication, verifying correct handling of subexpressions. Both tests are mathematically validated by reference checks, with exact expected outputs (16 and 20) confirmed via rational arithmetic. The tests cover the full scope of nested parentheses as required, including operator precedence and correct evaluation order. No additional tests are needed to validate this specific requirement, as the provided cases fully satisfy the intent.
